chunks: And he (peace be upon him) used to say when he faced the enemy in battle:
ai.seo_question: What was the supplication of Imam Ali when he faced the enemy?
ai.summary: This opening phrase sets the solemn context for the supplication recited by Imam Ali (AS) upon encountering the enemy, reflecting the Shia tradition of combining martial readiness with spiritual devotion. It highlights the transition from the physical act of facing combat to the metaphysical reliance on divine support, a practice deeply rooted in the Battle of Siffin and other key engagements. The phrase underscores the concept of 'muharabah' (armed conflict) as a sacred duty performed with conscious intent (niyyah).
